\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\footnotesize\raggedright
K1 (accuracy parity, shaped vs AR): displacement $-$4.7\% (resolution 10\%), energy gap $-$4.6\% (resolution 10\%): not triggered.\par
Effect (S of the shaped arm minus S of the AR arm, per seed): +0.009 / +0.014 / +0.002; the pre-registered floor is 0.02 in every seed: not met. Verdict: NO-GO.\par
256 validation instances; seed mean $\pm$ sample SD. S: silhouette of the pooled latents over geometry bins; probe R$^2$: linear probe of the geometry descriptor; 1-NN: leave-one-out bin accuracy, chance 0.25 with 4 bins of 64.\par
The geometry descriptor is also a per-node model input, so S, the probe and 1-NN largely read the input back; they are not evidence of learned geometry. Untrained rows (post-hoc reading 4a, same instances): models built from the AR arm's configuration at initialisation with the descriptor input; the same models with the descriptor's input weights set to zero; models built without the descriptor input.\par
The raw-token ablation ran one seed and is reported only.
